description: Read one known private purchase using its order ID and matching capability. Returns the current revision, payment state and order.cards with each card’s production and mailing states. Use it to check progress or refresh a stale revision; it does not change the order.

order_access_token.description: Exact private order_access_token returned by prepare_order or revise_order for this order. Keep it secret; never invent it or put it in a public URL or log.

order_id.description: Parent order.id returned by prepare_order, revise_order or read_order. Use the matching order_access_token; a card ID cannot identify the purchase.

name: read_order

design_key.description: Exact card.design.key from search_cards, or its occasion_design_keys entry for the selected occasion when present. Private cards use design_key from read_private_content or compose_private_card.

design_version.description: Matching card.design.version from the same search result, or design_version returned for the private composition. Never infer a version.

format.description: Postcard, flat card in an envelope, or folded card in an envelope. Omit to select flat_card_in_envelope.

include_paddock_gift.description: Include a complimentary personalized Paddock bookmark. For eligible new envelope orders, omission includes it; set false to opt out. The bookmark has the chosen artwork, a gift message naming the sender, and a unique QR code for one free card, including artist cards. Read the order’s returned paddock_gift: included, and omission_reason when it is not included. Explain it when useful or asked; no separate question or announcement is needed.

message.description: Body of the personal message, at most 2000 Unicode characters. Paddock prints the greeting "Dear {greeting_name or display_name}," above it automatically, so do not start the message with a salutation. Printed artwork wording is separate.

message_font.description: Font for the personal message: serif, sans_serif, old_school or handwriting. Omission uses serif. Artwork lettering is unchanged.

occasion.description: Optional occasion and timing context, independent of the selected artwork. Omit for an ordinary just-because card.

calendar.description: Must be us-western-v1, the supported occasion calendar.

day.description: Day valid for occasion.month, required for personal annual occasions such as anniversary. Birthdays use recipient.birthday_day.

kind.description: Exact catalog occasion ID, such as birthday, thank_you or just_because. Use just_because with send_on for a one-time mailing date. Use underscores, not display labels or hyphens.

month.description: Required with day for a personal annual occasion such as anniversary. Omit for holidays and one-off occasions; birthdays use recipient.birthday_month.

send_on.description: Requested mailing date as YYYY-MM-DD, only for one-off occasions such as just_because. Omit for the next available mailing date. This is not a delivery guarantee.

address_confirmed.description: Must be true: the buyer has confirmed the supplied mailing address.

anniversary_day.description: Optional anniversary day valid for anniversary_month; supply both fields together or omit both. Paired zeros mean unknown.

anniversary_month.description: Optional recipient anniversary month, paired with anniversary_day. Use 1 through 12, or 0 for both when unknown. Mailing timing uses occasion.month and occasion.day.

birthday_year.description: Known birth year, optional. Requires a valid full birth date that is not in the future. Omit or use null when unknown.

display_name.description: Name on the envelope or address panel.

greeting_name.description: Name printed in the automatic greeting, such as Ida for "Dear Ida,". Defaults to display_name.

country_code.description: Two-letter uppercase ISO country code, such as US or CA. The recipient country determines the price and postal rules.

line1.description: Street address or postal delivery line supplied by the buyer.

postal_code.description: Postal or ZIP code; use an empty string where the destination does not use one.

region.description: State, province or region; use an empty string where the destination does not require one.

origin.description: Must be manual: recipient details come from the buyer, without a member recipient ID or Contacts import.

display_name.description: Sender name printed with the return address.

country_code.description: Two-letter uppercase ISO country code, such as US or CA. The recipient country determines the price and postal rules.

line1.description: Street address or postal delivery line supplied by the buyer.

postal_code.description: Postal or ZIP code; use an empty string where the destination does not use one.

region.description: State, province or region; use an empty string where the destination does not require one.

source_kind.description: Must be manual: the buyer supplies this address; billing and saved Home addresses are not inferred.

envelope.description: Present only for formats mailed in an envelope.

message_surface.description: Where Paddock prints the personal message.

open_size_in.description: Folded card only: size when opened.

paper.description: Card stock by its confirmed basis-weight designation.

caliper_in.description: Measured sheet thickness in inches; absent when unknown.

color.description: Absent until confirmed for the stock in use.

finish.description: Absent until confirmed for the stock in use.

size_in.description: Finished size in inches; the closed size for the folded card.

title: Read an order
